_comment: Files present in two or more wikis, outside SHARED, whose contents disagree. A debt register, not an exemption: it must only ever shrink. Some entries are CORRECT and permanent -- design/federation.json is per-repo by design -- but recording that is a claim someone makes on purpose. --check fails on anything not listed.

drifted.reason: BY ROLE — up-flow tooling; a top commons has nothing above it.
DELIBERATELY PERSONAL — the CRM must never reach a commons, and shipping the skill invites the pages.
BY ROLE — a publishing surface, not a discipline.

BY ROLE — the gate set is not the same in every wiki, because the tools are not. This repo runs check_sources.py and sync_index_counts.py, which most wikis do not have. The one part that WAS shared drift — a hand-kept list of test files that covered 8 of 17 suites — was fixed on 2026-09-04 by making the step discover tools/test_*.py. What remains is each repo's own gates.

BY ROLE, AND A DECISION NOT MINE — a Pages deploy workflow. power-project-wiki has a docs/ directory but deliberately no deploy; syncing this would START PUBLISHING a repo that is not published today. Turning on a publication surface is a decision for a person, not a sync.
BY ROLE — the colleague mirror. Which repo it pushes to, and whether it runs at all, is a fact about this wiki's position in the graph, not a shared behaviour.

BY ROLE — a commons publishes two graphs to its export branch (wiki.public.json AND wiki.shared.json); a spoke publishes one. Same division already recorded for tools/export.py, and the workflow's own SECURITY comment states it.

TRIAGED — held pending one decision. Runs daily with contents:write and pull-requests:write. Nine wikis have it; xco-team-wiki does not, so sharing it would create a daily write-permission job in the shared commons. The drift between the nine is small (the source is a superset); share it the moment someone decides xco-team should have it.

CORRECT AND PERMANENT — the merge base. It records what the sync last WROTE into THIS repo, so a local change can be told apart from the source moving on. Identical copies would mean the record was not per-repo, which is the bug it exists to prevent.
CORRECT AND PERMANENT — a wiki's position in the graph does not travel. Ten versions across ten repos is the designed state.
CORRECT — per-repo branding for the social card.

CORRECT AND PER-REPO — a catalogue of THIS wiki's tools. The tool sets differ, so the READMEs must. (The naming difference that also showed here is not drift: a personal wiki's README may name its owner.)
DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE — learning-system-wiki's copy is de-projectised on purpose and says so: 'no project-specific strategy vocabulary … this file is versioned, and in an open repo'.
BY ROLE — a commons emits wiki.shared.json and provenance; a spoke does not. Documented in the file's own header.
BY ROLE — carries a repo-specific PATTERNS block matching that router's headings.

BY ROLE — pairs with sync_index_counts.py, already recorded as by-role: it carries a repo-specific PATTERNS block matching that router's headings. Only the two tiered-index wikis have either. A test cannot travel further than the tool it tests.
